language.name: Kestrel News Report
language.rationale: This design language balances the authoritative and calm tone required for public-broadcast news with the kinetic and energetic brand identity of Kestrel Athletic. It uses the brand's dark primary surface for gravitas, offset by their signature Volt accent, while maintaining clear typographic hierarchy and generous spacing for readability.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (airy density - 33/46px padding, 16px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a rule across the top of the panel, one clear space above the words
motion: reveal at measured pace → preset line-reveal
